20261122-physics-m2-1.title: Nyocha circuit ọzọ
20261122-physics-m2-1.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Nyocha circuit ọzọ iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261122-physics-m2-1.material: [Nyocha circuit ọzọ] E jikọtara nguzogide 6 Ω na 3 Ω n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ma jikọọ ya na isi mmalite ike 12 V. Kedu ngụkọta ọkụ eletrik na-agafe circuit niile?
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.prompt: [Nyocha circuit ọzọ] E jikọtara nguzogide 6 Ω na 3 Ω n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ma jikọọ ya na isi mmalite ike 12 V. Kedu ngụkọta ọkụ eletrik na-agafe circuit niile?
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.explain: Ngụkọta nguzogide nke njikọ parallel bụ $\frac{1}{R_p} = \frac{1}{6} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{2} \implies R_p = 2\,\Omega$. Ngụkọta ọkụ eletrik bụ $I = \frac{12\text{ V}}{2\,\Omega} = 6\text{ A}$.
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Ngụkọta nguzogide nke parallel: 1/R = 1/6 + 1/3 = 3/6 = 1/2, ya mere R = 2 Ω.
20261122-physics-m2-1.s.s1.hint.1: Gbakọọ ngụkọta ọkụ eletrik I = V / R = 12 / 2.
20261122-physics-m2-1.steps.0.prompt: [Nyocha circuit ọzọ] E jikọtara nguzogide 6 Ω na 3 Ω n'otu ụzọ (parallel) ma jikọọ ya na isi mmalite ike 12 V. Kedu ngụkọta ọkụ eletrik na-agafe circuit niile?

20261122-physics-m2-2.title: a kpuchikwa mgbidi dị n'ime ya na 'ọlaọcha'
20261122-physics-m2-2.topic: a kpuchikwa mgbidi dị n'ime ya na 'ọlaọcha'
20261122-physics-m2-2.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke a kpuchikwa mgbidi dị n'ime ya na 'ọlaọcha' iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261122-physics-m2-2.material: Ite nke na-edebe ihe ọṅụṅụ ọkụ ogologo oge nwere 'vacuum' (ebe ikuku na-adịghị) n'etiti mgbidi abụọ ya, a kpuchikwa mgbidi dị n'ime ya na 'ọlaọcha'. Kedu nhọrọ jikọtara ọ bụla n'ime ha na ụzọ mgbasa okpomọkụ ọ na-egbochi nke ọma?
20261122-physics-m2-2.thinking.0: a kpuchikwa mgbidi dị n'ime ya na 'ọlaọcha'
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.prompt: Ite nke na-edebe ihe ọṅụṅụ ọkụ ogologo oge nwere 'vacuum' (ebe ikuku na-adịghị) n'etiti mgbidi abụọ ya, a kpuchikwa mgbidi dị n'ime ya na 'ọlaọcha'. Kedu nhọrọ jikọtara ọ bụla n'ime ha na ụzọ mgbasa okpomọkụ ọ na-egbochi nke ọma?
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.explain: Oyi vacuum enweghị ihe n'ime ya, yabụ ọ na-egbochi mgbasa okpomọkụ site n'imetụ na n'ịtụgharị kpamkpam, ebe mgbidi ọlaọcha na-egbuke egbuke na-eweghachi okpomọkụ radieshọn infrared n'ime, na-egbochi mfu okpomọkụ.
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Vacuum enweghị ihe ọ bụla n'ime ya, yabụ ọ na-egbochi mgbasa site n'imetụ na n'ịtụgharị, bụ́ ndị chọrọ ihe.
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Ọlaọcha kpuchiri na-eweghachi okpomọkụ radieshọn, nke bụ ebili mmiri electromagnetic (infrared).
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Mgbidi vacuum abụọ: na-egbochi mgbasa site n'imetụ (conduction) na n'ịtụgharị (convection) / ime ọlaọcha kpuchiri: na-egbochi mfu okpomọkụ site na radieshọn
20261122-physics-m2-2.s.s1.o.o1: Mgbidi vacuum abụọ: na-egbochi radieshọn / ime ọlaọcha kpuchiri: na-egbochi mgbasa site n'imetụ
